label: DRAFT — drafted 2026-10-28 with Decision 27; awaiting owner sign-off. Strings may change.
scope: Decision 27 / TECH-SPEC §7.13 — the Settings Account card and its type-to-confirm modal.

strings.section_intro: Wipe your data to replay onboarding, or delete your account and everything in it.
strings.reset_hint: Dev only — deletes your data and restarts the interview. Your sign-in stays.
strings.delete_hint: Deletes your account and all of your data. This cannot be undone.
strings.modal_reset_body: This deletes your messages, check-ins, journal, metrics, habits, memory and pending jobs, then restarts onboarding. Your sign-in stays, so you can do this again. There is no undo.
strings.modal_delete_body: This deletes your account and every row tied to it — messages, check-ins, journal, metrics, habits, memory and pending jobs. There is no undo. Signing in again creates a new, empty account.
strings.error_confirmation: The confirmation didn't match. Nothing was changed.
strings.error_session: Your session expired. Sign in again, then retry.
strings.error_disabled: Account changes are turned off right now.
strings.error_generic_reset: Your data wasn't reset. Try again.
strings.error_generic_delete: We couldn't finish deleting your account. Try again — repeating it is safe.
